notes:
Build lab/foldhist.json: inventory of every folding technique/experiment run so far.

Evidence levels:
  receipt  = number read this session from a report/receipt that cites sealed artifacts
  report   = number read this session from a campaign report written by an agent (not re-derived)
  memory   = number read from a Claude memory note (agent-written; not re-checked against the receipt)
  codex    = number read from Codex's audit (OBJECTIVE_HISTORY_AND_RECOVERY_BACKLOG.md), not recomputed
Ratios: 'net' = child params / parent params (storage counted in parameters).
'per-component' = folded component params / original component params.
